properties.title: Russia strikes Ukraine intelligence HQ in ‘major escalation’
properties.summary: Volodymyr Zelenskyy says he has told SBU to deliver ‘appropriate, tangible response’ to Kyiv strike The head office of Ukraine’s SBU intelligence agency has been hit in a Russian drone attack, sending plumes of black smoke rising into the air in the heart of Kyiv. Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said he had instructed the SBU to deliver an “appropriate, tangible response” to the strike, while the foreign minister, Andrii Sybiha, described it as a “major escalation”. properties.title: Slovakia rejects EU’s plan to lock in Russia sanctions for 12 months
properties.summary: BRUSSELS — The Slovak government on Wednesday rejected a 12-month extension for the EU’s individual sanctions package against Russia, three diplomats told POLITICO.
